//============================================================================
//! 8x16 character generator ROM - GENERATED by font/make_font.py.
//! DO NOT HAND-EDIT: re-run  python3 font/make_font.py <psf> font8x16.hex
//! (from Verilog/Terminals/) and commit both the .hex and this .v.
//!
//! source font: /usr/share/consolefonts/Lat15-VGA16.psf.gz
//!
//! Four 128-glyph pages x 16 rows x 8 pixels = 8192 bytes. Address is
//! {char_code, row}; char_code is {page[1:0], code[6:0]}:
//!   page 0 = US / ISO 646 IRV      page 1 = Norwegian (NS 4551-1)
//!   page 2 = TDV2200 char set 2    page 3 = DEC Special Graphics
//! page 2 is the TDV build's box set (ESC 6 and SS2); page 3 is the
//! VT100 build's line drawing. GFX_PAGE in text_screen.v picks which.
//!
//! The DATA IS EMBEDDED below (no $readmemh, no font8x16.hex) so this ROM
//! compiles identically on every board and tool with nothing to find or
//! let go stale - see write_font_rom_v() in make_font.py for the full why.
//! One clock of read latency, registered output - infers a block RAM on
//! both Xilinx and Intel rather than a pile of LUTs.
//============================================================================

`default_nettype none

module font_rom #(
    //! Ignored - the font data is embedded below, not read from a file.
    //! Kept so existing instantiations that pass .FONT_FILE(...) still
    //! elaborate unchanged.
    parameter FONT_FILE = "embedded"
) (
    input  wire       clk,        //! pixel clock
    input  wire [8:0] char_code,  //! {page[1:0], code[6:0]}
    input  wire [3:0] row,        //! which of its 16 pixel rows
    output reg  [7:0] pixels      //! that row, MSB = leftmost. Valid one clock later
);

  (* rom_style = "block" *)
  reg [7:0] s_rom[0:8191];

  initial begin
    s_rom[13'd0] = 8'h00;
    s_rom[13'd1] = 8'h00;
    s_rom[13'd2] = 8'h00;
    s_rom[13'd3] = 8'h00;
